name: Mitch
title: Striking Coach
bio: Mitchell Reed is a fighter at Harbinger and a former hockey player with a passion for mixed martial arts. He coaches Kickboxing Fundamentals, bringing a well-rounded approach to striking that draws from Muay Thai, Taekwondo, Kyokushin, and Boxing. His focus is on practical, effective techniques tailored for MMA.
excerpt: Mitch is a well-rounded striking coach, teaching practical techniques from Muay Thai, Taekwondo, Kyokushin, and Boxing for MMA.
